title.context: AI = the automatic reader that builds a setlist from a file

descriptionInput.where: Setlist importer dialog: subtitle on the first (choose a file) step

descriptionProcessing.where: Setlist importer dialog: subtitle while the file is being read

descriptionReview.where: Setlist importer dialog: subtitle on the spreadsheet review table step
descriptionReview.context: charts = sheet-music files; Drive = Google Drive

descriptionInterview.where: Setlist importer dialog: subtitle on the details form after reading a document

descriptionPreview.where: Setlist importer dialog: subtitle on the final preview step

sheetsUrlLabel.where: Setlist importer, first step: label over the Google Sheets link field
sheetsUrlLabel.context: Google Sheets is a product name

sheetsSharingHint.where: Setlist importer, first step: hint under the Google Sheets link field
sheetsSharingHint.context: The quoted text is the Google sharing option's wording; use the name Google shows in the user's language

or.where: Setlist importer, first step: divider between the three import options (shown uppercase)

uploadCsvLabel.where: Setlist importer, first step: label over the CSV file drop box
uploadCsvLabel.context: CSV is a file format; keep it

selectCsvFile.where: Setlist importer, first step: text inside the CSV file box before a file is chosen
selectCsvFile.context: .csv is a file extension; keep it

dragDropDisabled.where: Setlist importer, first step: small hint inside the CSV file box

uploadCsvAria.where: Setlist importer, first step: screen-reader name of the CSV file input

uploadDocumentLabel.where: Setlist importer, first step: label over the document file box

selectDocumentFile.where: Setlist importer, first step: text inside the document file box before a file is chosen

documentHint.where: Setlist importer, first step: small hint inside the document file box

uploadDocumentAria.where: Setlist importer, first step: screen-reader name of the document file input

analyzing.where: Setlist importer, first step: main button while the file is being read

nextAnalyzeDocument.where: Setlist importer, first step: main button when a document is chosen

nextAnalyzeSpreadsheet.where: Setlist importer, first step: main button for a spreadsheet link or CSV

readingDocumentHeading.where: Setlist importer, processing step: heading while a document is read

analyzingRowsHeading.where: Setlist importer, processing step: heading while a spreadsheet is read

readingDocumentBody.where: Setlist importer, processing step: text under the heading for a document

analyzingRowsBody.where: Setlist importer, processing step: text under the heading for a spreadsheet
analyzingRowsBody.context: Gemini is the name of the AI service; Google Drive is a product name

columnType.where: Setlist importer, review table: column header (row kind: header or song; shown uppercase)

columnTitle.where: Setlist importer, review table: column header for the song title

columnKeyVocalLead.where: Setlist importer, review table: column header for musical key and Vocal Lead
columnKeyVocalLead.context: Key = musical key (C, Bb…); Vocal Lead = the singer leading the song (never just 'Lead')

columnStatus.where: Setlist importer, review table: column header for library match and chart-link status

rowHeader.where: Setlist importer, review table: badge on a section-header row (shown uppercase)
rowHeader.context: A section heading inside the setlist, not a song

rowSong.where: Setlist importer, review table: badge on a song row

keyPlaceholder.where: Setlist importer, review table: placeholder of the small musical-key field
keyPlaceholder.context: Musical key; the field is very narrow

vocalLeadPlaceholder.where: Setlist importer, review table: placeholder of the Vocal Lead field
vocalLeadPlaceholder.context: Vocal Lead = the singer leading the song (never just 'Lead')

privateDriveLink.where: Setlist importer, review table: red warning when the chart's Google Drive link is private

invalidLink.where: Setlist importer, review table: red warning when the chart link is not valid

hasDriveLink.where: Setlist importer, review table: green status when the row has a Google Drive chart link

noChartLink.where: Setlist importer, review table: status when a song row has no chart link

matchesLibrary.where: Setlist importer: status/tooltip when a song matches a chart already in the library
matchesLibrary.context: {name} is the matching library chart's name (shown bold)

songsFound.where: Setlist importer, review footer: number of songs found in the spreadsheet
songsFound.context: {count} is a number (shown bold). English keeps today's text '1 songs found' for one.

newDrivePdfs.where: Setlist importer, review footer: how many new chart PDFs will be downloaded from Google Drive
newDrivePdfs.context: {count} is a number (shown bold). English keeps the plural for one.

back.where: Setlist importer: footer button returning to the previous step

executing.where: Setlist importer, review footer: main button while the import runs

finalizeImport.where: Setlist importer, review footer: main button that creates the setlist from the spreadsheet

setlistNameLabel.where: Setlist importer, details form: label of the setlist name field

serviceDateLabel.where: Setlist importer, details form: label of the required service date field (followed by a red *)

serviceDateHint.where: Setlist importer, details form: hint under the service date field

serviceTypeLabel.where: Setlist importer, details form: label of the service type picker

serviceTypeHint.where: Setlist importer, details form: hint under the service type picker

serviceType.shabbat_morning.where: Setlist importer: service type option and preview label

serviceType.friday_night.where: Setlist importer: service type option and preview label

serviceType.rosh_hashanah.where: Setlist importer: service type option and preview label

serviceType.yom_kippur.where: Setlist importer: service type option and preview label

serviceType.festival.where: Setlist importer: service type option and preview label

serviceType.other.where: Setlist importer: service type option and preview label

rabbiLabel.where: Setlist importer, details form: label of the rabbi field

optional.where: Setlist importer, details form: small marker after the rabbi label

rabbiPlaceholder.where: Setlist importer, details form: placeholder of the rabbi field
rabbiPlaceholder.context: The person leading the service ('Led by' is distinct from Vocal Lead)

startOver.where: Setlist importer, details form: footer button that discards the read document and returns to the start

nextPreview.where: Setlist importer, details form: footer button to the preview step

untitledSetlist.where: Setlist importer, preview header: shown when the setlist name is empty

defaultSetlistName.where: Setlist importer: default name of the new setlist (pre-filled, and saved as the setlist name for spreadsheet imports)
defaultSetlistName.context: Becomes data: saved as the setlist's name; the leader can rename it

noTracks.where: Setlist importer, preview: empty state when the document gave no songs

ungrouped.where: Setlist importer, preview: section heading for songs not under any section (shown uppercase)

missingChart.where: Setlist importer, preview: amber status on a song with no matching chart

recordingCandidates.where: Setlist importer, preview: tooltip on the recordings count icon
recordingCandidates.context: {count} is the number of possible recordings found for the song

trackCount.where: Setlist importer, preview footer: number of songs in the new setlist
trackCount.context: {count} is a number (shown bold). English keeps the plural for one.

missingChartCount.where: Setlist importer, preview footer: number of songs without a chart

creating.where: Setlist importer, preview footer: main button while the setlist is created

createSetlist.where: Setlist importer, preview footer: main button that creates the setlist

selectDocument.where: Setlist importer: error toast when no document is chosen

readDocumentFailed.where: Setlist importer: error toast when the server could not read the document

extractStructureFailed.where: Setlist importer: error toast when the AI could not find the setlist structure

resolveTracksFailed.where: Setlist importer: error toast when songs could not be matched to the library

processDocumentError.where: Setlist importer: generic error toast for a document import

provideUrlOrCsv.where: Setlist importer: error toast when neither a link nor a CSV was given

parseFailed.where: Setlist importer: error toast when the spreadsheet could not be read

serverErrorRequestTimeout.where: Setlist importer: error toast for a server failure while reading a spreadsheet
serverErrorRequestTimeout.context: {status} is an HTTP status number; {statusText} is the server's English status text (e.g. 'Gateway Timeout')

parseSpreadsheetError.where: Setlist importer: generic error toast for a spreadsheet import

createSetlistFailed.where: Setlist importer: error toast when the setlist could not be created

setlistCreated.where: Setlist importer: success toast after creating the setlist from a document

createSetlistError.where: Setlist importer: generic error toast when creating the setlist failed

executeFailed.where: Setlist importer: error toast when the spreadsheet import failed

serverErrorUploadTimeout.where: Setlist importer: error toast for a server failure while importing a spreadsheet
serverErrorUploadTimeout.context: {status} is an HTTP status number; {statusText} is the server's English status text

setlistImported.where: Setlist importer: success toast after a spreadsheet import

executeImportError.where: Setlist importer: generic error toast when the spreadsheet import failed
